log.b: Goat rolls 3 + 14 − 0 armour penalty = 17.
Border Deserter rolls 8 + 12 − 0 armour penalty = 20.
Goat: 3+14−0 = 17. Border Deserter: 8+12−0 = 20. Border Deserter acts first.
39 against Combat Style 47% — SUCCESS.
46 vs 100% — SUCCESS. 3 AP remaining.

Goat's Broadsword parry stops the whole blow (Core p.95: a parrying weapon as large as the attacking one blocks all its damage), and it cannot land hard enough to knock them back, so no location or damage is rolled.
89 against Combat Style 100% — SUCCESS.
47 vs 47% — SUCCESS. 0 AP remaining.

Border Deserter's Broadsword parry stops the whole blow (Core p.95: a parrying weapon as large as the attacking one blocks all its damage), and it cannot land hard enough to knock them back, so no location or damage is rolled.
69 against Combat Style 100% — SUCCESS.
Border Deserter has no Action Points left, so cannot parry or evade. The attack is undefended.
Goat gains 1 Special Effect from superior success.
Weapon damage will be rolled twice; choose a result.
Goat rolls 16 (d20): Left Arm.
Goat chooses option B: 6 weapon damage before the Damage Modifier.
6 weapon (6) +1d4 (+2) = 8 total; 0 parry; 0 armour; 8 HP lost.
Goat's Broadsword lodges in Border Deserter's Left Arm. Choose: keep hold and pull it free on a later turn, or leave it in the wound.
Goat keeps hold of the weapon and can pull it free on a later turn (Ready Weapon).
Border Deserter Endurance 60/27% (FAILURE) versus the attack 69 (SUCCESS). Fails to resist. Endurance 53% made harder by impaled weapon.

Goat wins. Border Deserter has a Major Limb Wound to the Left Arm: incapacitated and prone. Falls unconscious from agony. If the GM rules the limb severed, punctured or ripped off, untreated blood loss becomes fatal after 10 minutes.
